answer.text: The manual describes the battery only as a 12 V - 8 Ah VRLA battery.
The electrical specifications also list the battery as 12 V - 8 Ah VRLA; 8 Ah is a capacity rating, not a cold cranking amps figure.

disclaimers.text: The admitted manual evidence does not state a cold cranking amps (CCA) rating for the battery, so I cannot give one.
For a CCA figure, check the label on the battery itself or ask a Royal Enfield Authorised Service Centre.
